title: Delicious Miss Brown
description:

Kardea Brown makes the most of a free day by preparing dishes that make perfect leftovers; first up is chicken pot pie, and she makes plenty of cheesy country ham grit balls with spicy mayo and some pan-roasted sage and butternut squash.

title: Delicious Miss Brown
description:
S05 E10 — Friendsgiving
Kardea Brown invites her best friends over for Friendsgiving, and she's in charge of the turkey and side dishes; deviled crabs in the shell, a Cajun butter spatchcock turkey, fried cabbage and sweet potato stuffed cornbread.

title: Delicious Miss Brown
description:
S09 E06 — Fall Fest
Kardea Brown celebrates her favorite season with a fall-inspired menu of braised pulled pork sliders with apple slaw, sweet potato chips with sweet and spicy mustard sauce, spiked mulled apple cider and apple cider donuts with pumpkin spice glaze.

title: Delicious Miss Brown
description:

Kardea Brown shares down-home, Southern eats from her South Carolina kitchen. She takes generations of family recipes and makes them her own as she cooks for family and friends at her Sea Island home.

title: The Pioneer Woman

Ree Drummond celebrates a frontier-style Friendsgiving celebration with friends; turkey roulade rolled around sausage stuffing; leek and potato casserole as a mashed potato substitute; adventurous sides; pomegranate cocktail.

Ree Drummond is in the holiday spirit, sharing sweets for a Thanksgiving feast; she bakes up a spiced pumpkin cream cake, a cranberry orange trifle, a classic sheet pan Dutch apple tart and pretzel white chocolate cookies.

title: The Pioneer Woman
description:

Legendary green bean casserole made from scratch; sweet potato rolls; molded cranberry salad; old-fashioned custard pie puts the spotlight on dessert.

Danielle Sepsy teams up with her mom to make Pepperoni Stromboli with a flavorful filling and golden crust; Danielle welcomes her grandma to the kitchen to make a Mile High Classic Top-Heavy Deli Crumb Cake with a thick layer of buttery crumbs.

title: Best Bake Ever With Danielle Sepsy
description:
S01 E03 — From Produce to Pastry
Transforming everyday fruits and vegetables into comforting, bakery-style treats; first, creating a Best Carrot Cake, layering moist cake with tangy cream cheese frosting; then, ripe bananas become soft, sweet Sugar Cookie Banana Bread.

title: The Kitchen
description:

Sharing some tips, tricks and no-fail recipes for Thanksgiving, including pimento cheese pepper poppers, coffee chili-rubbed turkey tenderloin with red eye BBQ sauce and pommes aligot.

Ree Drummond's daughter, Paige, returns to work for the family business. Ree stocks her fridge with Sausage, Potato and Corn Chowder, grab-and-go Croissant Breakfast Sandwiches, easy Homemade Pizza Snacks and Chocolate Toffee Crunch Cookies.

Native American chefs who revere indigenous culinary traditions compete in a first-of-its-kind battle; every basket is packed with ingredients known and loved in native communities, like sumac and whitefish for the first round.

description:

An over-reduced sauce and undercooked venison are potential problems in the first round; with Mexican chocolate in the dessert basket, it seems like the judges are in for a treat; one of the chef's time management woes are worrying.

The chef who cracks the code on this special competition's egg-centric baskets will win $10,000; delicate eggs and smoked seafood are part of the appetizer round challenge; the finalists find a giant egg in the dessert basket.
